entity: Tesla's California Cal/OSHA accident inspections: count, open share, time to close
what_we_add: 43 accident inspections since 2015, 18 still open, and the median 486 days to close vs 139-251 for peer employers
why: Forbes twice reports Tesla leading automakers in Cal/OSHA investigations and violations, and the AFL-CIO memo reports 27 open cases with Tesla contesting to prolong them — same entity, same direction. Their counts cover different inspection types and windows; our accident-only counts and the closure-time comparison are ours.
